# Golden cases of the command line tools, run in this folder.
#
# case NAME     starts a case; out/NAME.golden holds what the C++ tool printed
# tool T        hunspell (default), analyze or chmorph
# args ...      the arguments; '...' quotes, @HOME@ is the home folder
# stdin FILE    the standard input (empty by default)
# env K=V ...   the whole environment (default LC_ALL=C), "env -" for none
# home H        HOME is a fresh copy of homes/H ("-" for an empty one)
# file F        the file F of HOME is compared after the run
# nostderr      stderr is not compared (it is unzip's)
# diclist       the -D listing is sorted, without the system folders

# ---- help and version
case help
args -h
case help_long
args --help -d dict/nonexistent
case version
args -v
case version_long
args --version
case version_vv
args -vv -h

# ---- error paths and exit codes
case missing_dict
args -l -d dict/nonexistent
stdin in/words.txt
case missing_dict_env
env LC_ALL=C DICTIONARY=nonexistent_XX
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case missing_dict_comma
args -l -d dict/nonexistent,dict/small
stdin in/words.txt
case missing_aff
args -l -d dict/extra
stdin in/words.txt
case missing_file
args -l -d dict/small in/nonexistent.txt
case missing_second_file
args -l -d dict/small in/words.txt in/nonexistent.txt
case options_after_file
args -l in/words.txt -d dict/small
case unknown_options
args -l -x --bogus -q -d dict/small
stdin in/words.txt
case empty_argument
args -l '' -d dict/small
stdin in/words.txt
case interactive
args -d dict/small in/words.txt
case dangling_d
args -l -d dict/small -d
stdin in/words.txt

# ---- dictionaries
case multi_dict
args -l -d dict/small,../../hunspell/base
stdin in/plain.txt
case multi_dict_pipe
args -a -d ../../hunspell/base,dict/small
stdin in/plain.txt
case multi_dict_add_dic
args -a -d dict/small,dict/extra
stdin in/plain.txt
case multi_dict_bad_dic
args -l -d dict/small,dict/badcount
stdin in/words.txt
case multi_dict_missing
args -l -d dict/small,dict/nonexistent,../../hunspell/base
stdin in/words.txt
case dict_limit
args -l -d dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small,dict/small
stdin in/words.txt
case dict_errors
args -l -d dict/badflags
stdin in/words.txt
case encrypted
args -P s3cret -a -d dict/enc
stdin in/words.txt
case encrypted_wrong_key
args -P wrong -l -d dict/enc
stdin in/words.txt
case encrypted_no_key
args -l -d dict/enc
stdin in/words.txt

# ---- dictionary search path (-D) and default dictionary
case list_dicts
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=dict
args -D
diclist
case list_dicts_env
env LC_ALL=C HOME=/nonexistent/home DICPATH=dict::/nonexistent XDG_DATA_HOME=relative XDG_DATA_DIRS=rel:/abs/data
args -D -d small
diclist
case list_dicts_xdg
env LC_ALL=C XDG_DATA_HOME=/xdg/home XDG_DATA_DIRS=/xdg/a:/xdg/b:/xdg/a
args -D -d dict/small
diclist
case list_dicts_input
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=dict
args -D -l -d small,ver,nonexistent,extra in/words.txt
diclist
case list_dicts_missing
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=dict
args -D -l -d nonexistent
diclist
case list_dicts_hz
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=dict
args -D -P s3cret -d enc
diclist
case default_dictionary_env
env LC_ALL=C DICTIONARY=dict/small
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_dicpath
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=/nonexistent:dict DICTIONARY=small
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_lc_messages
env LC_CTYPE=C LC_MESSAGES=small.ISO-8859-1@euro DICPATH=dict
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_lang
env LC_CTYPE=C LANG=small@x DICPATH=dict
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_c_locale
env LC_ALL=C DICPATH=../../en_US
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_posix
env LC_ALL=POSIX DICPATH=../../en_US
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_no_locale
env DICPATH=../../en_US
args -l
stdin in/words.txt
case default_c_utf8
env LANG=C.UTF-8 DICPATH=../../en_US
args -a
stdin in/utf8.txt
